orchestrator.name: Ads Team Orchestrator
orchestrator.responsibility: Route structured artifacts through the research-to-repeat workflow and enforce approvals, policy, evidence, and idempotency.

employees.responsibility: Research competitors, audiences, offers, economics, and produce StrategyBrief.
Generate roughly twelve hooks per angle, rank the strongest three, and produce placement-aware copy.
Prepare static, video, and carousel variants for 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 placements.
Prepare campaign, ad-set, targeting, budget, and launch drafts without direct spend authority.
Check data sufficiency and produce guarded pause, reduce, hold, or scale recommendations.
Normalize metrics, reconcile attribution with real sales, diagnose leaks, and create next-test briefs.
Prepare reports, chase approvals through configured channels, and maintain the client decision thread.
